details: CONFIRMED. The flow is apply-review (review, fix, check) -> archive -> merge (apply-review SKILL.md:186 "archive first,
then the merge"; rules/openspec.md stage list). sdd:archive step 4 "Docs sweep" edits CLAUDE.md, README.md, skills and
docs pages whenever the change adds a command/term/module or changes how to run it, which is ordinary for a feature
change; step 5 commits everything in one archive commit. relay_inert.changed(..., archive=True) keeps README.md listed
(correctly, per the brief), so step_mark refuses. The added paragraph turns this into "the merge asks for both again",
but the check (judge base step 1 via bin/relay cmd_changed, no archive option) then counts the openspec move plus the docs
as "changed since the review", open +1 with Fixes: none, so the dead end the queue item described (1 refused merge, 1
extra gate, 1 extra checker, and here still refused) remains on the common path. The brief's pass case was "merges on the
first try (or the skill says exactly which re-runs are needed and they are enough)"; neither holds when the docs sweep
changes a non-inert file. The fix lies inside the file the change touched (the skill text) without touching the judge
base: move the docs sweep ahead of the check so it is reviewed and gated with the code. Size: 15.
evidence: $ python3 scratchpad/probe/test_probe.py   (fixture of tests/test_archive_inert.py; archive() + README.md, one commit)
DOCS SWEEP: refused: after the check of 2dcba51..., wt/x changed README.md, which is not inert; check again
SKILL.md:58-71 step 4 Docs sweep (CLAUDE.md, README.md, skills, docs); :73-75 "the archive changes only openspec/ and docs,
so it needs no new pipeline"; :77-82 new paragraph "Any other file in it (code, docs ...) makes the merge ask for both
again"; :86-87 step 5 one commit "Archive <change>: main specs synced".
bin/relay:468 relay_inert.changed(..., own=own)   # the checker's list: no archive filter
failing_case: A change that adds a command, archived per sdd:archive in order after apply-review's check: step 2/3 sync and move the
change, step 4 docs sweep updates README.md (or CLAUDE.md, a skill), step 5 commits it all as one
"Archive <change>: main specs synced" commit. Merge: refused, "after the check of <sha>, wt/x changed README.md, which is
not inert; check again". The skill now says "Archive after the check ... in its own commit" and "Any other file in it
(code, docs, ...) makes the merge ask for both again", while step 4 (same skill, same stage) puts docs in that very
commit, and the step-4 paragraph above still says "the archive changes only openspec/ and docs, so it needs no new
pipeline". The re-check the skill points to is not enough either: the checker's step 1 (`relay changed --own`, which
has no archive filter) lists README.md and every openspec/ file of the archive; with `Fixes: none` that is open +1, so the
new mark has open 1 and the merge is refused again. Should be: an archive done in the skill's order merges on the first
try, or the skill names re-runs that do clear it.
fix_hint: In SKILL.md: move "4. Docs sweep" before the check (say it runs as part of apply, committed before apply-review's check,
or make section 1 require it done), keep only docs/handover.md for after the archive, fix the step-4 "remote" paragraph
to say the archive commit is openspec-only, and say plainly: an archive commit that also changes docs or code needs a new
gate and a new review (not just a check).
pass_cases: 1. Artifact: SKILL.md places the docs sweep (README.md, CLAUDE.md, skills, docs pages) before the check of the change
(for example as the last apply task or a commit before apply-review's check), and states that the archive commit made
after the check holds only openspec/ paths (plus docs/handover.md, inert).
2. Artifact: no sentence of SKILL.md still says an archive that changes docs needs no new gate/pipeline; the step-4
"gate.final is remote" paragraph agrees with the new paragraph.
3. Artifact: step 5's commit description matches (the archive commit is openspec-only).
4. Behaviour kept (tests/test_archive_inert.py): archive-only commit after the mark allowed; same commit + code line
refused; edit of openspec/changes/x/tasks.md refused.
5. Probe: archive commit + README.md edit after the mark is still refused (the guard is not widened to docs).
reason: SKILL.md step 4 now runs before the check, the archive commit is openspec-only, no "no new pipeline" sentence remains, step 5 says openspec-only. Tests tests/test_archive_inert.py:70 and :76 pass.
findings.summary: the archive skill's own docs sweep (step 4) lands in the archive commit, so following the skill in order still gets the merge refused, and the re-check it names cannot clear it

details: CONFIRMED by probe. `_archiving` judges each path alone: openspec/specs/** is always filtered, and any deletion under
openspec/changes/*/ is filtered, with no condition that the span actually archives (adds the moved folder under
openspec/changes/archive/). It follows the letter of the brief ("every path it touches is under ..."), so it is LOW: main
specs are the project's source of truth, and an after-check edit of them now skips both review and gate. Size: 15.
failing_case: After the check mark, a commit that only rewrites a requirement in openspec/specs/word/spec.md (no change folder moved,
nothing added under openspec/changes/archive/) merges with no new check or gate: probe prints
"SPEC EDIT, NO ARCHIVE: allowed". Likewise `git rm -r openspec/changes/y` of an unrelated, unarchived change after the
mark: "DELETE OTHER CHANGE (no archive): allowed". Should be: refused, since nothing was archived; only the span that
moves a change into openspec/changes/archive/ is the archiving the skill describes.
fix_hint: In changed(archive=True): apply the filter only when the span deletes openspec/changes/<name>/... and adds
openspec/changes/archive/<...><name>/...; otherwise return the list unfiltered.
pass_cases: 1. Mark, then a commit editing only openspec/specs/word/spec.md -> judge raises Refused naming that file.
2. Mark, then `git rm -r openspec/changes/y` with nothing added under openspec/changes/archive/ -> Refused.
3. Mark, then archive() of tests/test_archive_inert.py (specs written, archive/2026-x/* added, changes/x/* deleted) ->
allowed.
4. Same archive plus code.py edit -> Refused.
reason: tests/test_archive_inert.py:91 and :97 pass and fail at 309b1cf; :70 (archive allowed) still passes.
findings.summary: any edit of openspec/specs/** (or deletion of any change folder) after the check is inert even when no archive happened

details: CONFIRMED by reading (relay_git.git:19-25; relay_inert.py:89). An error answered as success in a guard. Also one git
process per archived path per mark tried. Size: 5.
failing_case: relay_git.git returns (127, "") when git cannot run or times out; `_archiving` treats any non-zero exit of
`cat-file -e <until>:openspec/changes/x/tasks.md` as "the file is gone", so an edited tasks.md would be filtered out and
the merge allowed. Should be: a git failure raises (as `_git` does elsewhere in this module) and the merge is refused or
errors, never allowed.
fix_hint: Read `_blobs(repo, until)` once in changed() (it raises via _git on failure) and test `path not in blobs` for the
pass_cases: 1. relay_git.git patched to return (127, "") for cat-file: changed(..., archive=True) raises ValueError or keeps the path.
2. Edit of openspec/changes/x/tasks.md after the mark -> Refused (existing test).
3. Archive-only commit after the mark -> allowed (existing test).
reason: tests/test_archive_inert.py:103 passes (ValueError on failing ls-tree) and fails at 309b1cf.
findings.summary: a failing git cat-file (timeout, git cannot run) is read as 'deleted', so the merge guard fails open
